4 of 6 members present. Quorum established.

Agenda
Item 1
Workforce Analytics Platform Demo and Proposal

The committee discussed the findings of the recent audit related to the Workforce Analytics Platform Demo and Proposal. Micah Britt summarized the 151 findings and management's proposed remediation plan. The committee endorsed the plan and requested quarterly progress updates.

Motion

To approve for optimization: RESOLVED, that the Technology Subcommittee of the Board approves the 1994 annual report on Form 10-K for filing with the SEC.

Moved: Micah Britt  •  Seconded: Curtis Celik
Vote: 4 Yea  /  0 Nay  /  0 Abstain  —  CARRIED
Item 2
Current Report on Form 8-K — Recent Filings

The committee considered the Current Report on Form 8-K — Recent Filings, a proposal to adopt a new policy on transfer pricing. The policy was approved and will be implemented company-wide.

Item 3
Relative TSR Performance Calculation and Payout Certification

The committee received a report on the Relative TSR Performance Calculation and Payout Certification. The data indicated a negative trend that required immediate attention. The committee formed an ad hoc subcommittee to investigate the issue and report back with recommendations at the next meeting.

Motion

To approve for vote: RESOLVED, that the Technology Subcommittee of the Board approves the 1994 annual report on Form 10-K for filing with the SEC.

Moved: Vani Quinn  •  Seconded: Sola Michaels
Vote: 4 Yea  /  0 Nay  /  0 Abstain  —  CARRIED
